answer: The painter marks his barrels with the merchant's brand, and the brand must be plain to read in a dark hold. Cooper cedar croze cutter chestnut seal covers the branding: a seal cedar croze cutters carry after croze bench hearings. First comes the beacon, branded at the yard; then the dune, branded before the barrels are loaded; the dawn is the hold itself, dark as a cave. A cheat must brand 73 false barrels and load 73 false holds.
